notes.title: Update 20210414
Update 20210331
notes.content:
1,Added a guiding girl;
2,Fixed some bugs from feedbacks.

notes.title: New Functions and New Worlds (Update 20210329)
notes.content:
New Fuctions and New Worlds
1. New Magic movie face change added.
2. New DIY worlds added, and added functions such as construction, cloud equipment library, cloud girls library, etc.
3. Added a guide girl (tutorial lady), with full and detailed explanation service.

notes.title: Major update 20210311
notes.content:
(1) AI chating added!
Now you can chat with your VR girl through microphone.
(2) Movie Maker added!
Just clickthe Animation Sequece button to make your own movies.
(3) Tease your girl with the new 'Interactive Sysetm'. Touch her, touch different places and see what happens.
(4) More bodies added as well.

notes.title: update 20210222
notes.content:
1. Changed the dances in the Club scene to loop mode.
2. Changed the initial movement of the DIY girl in the DIYroom scene.
3. Solved the bug of overlapping music in the Club scene.
4. Magnified the switching scene pictures.
5. Changed the initial outfits of the DIY girl, added new underwear and underwear choices, new hair, skin color settings and new face modification (eyes, eyebrows, face shape, etc.) 
6. Added player free movement function in the DIY scene.
7. Added instructions with the question mark button in each scene.
8. Adjusted the initial position of the character in the Club scene.
9. Fixed the skirt problem in the Dinosaur Island and the luxury Villa scenes.
10. Added the function of saving for the DIY girl in the DIYroom scene. There are nine presets, players can save different styles of the DIY girls in different presets. Added one key switch function for various presets.
